hypothesis: Fresh-create startup serializes two session-file rewrites (~40 ms fsync each) and a worker identity persist (~40 ms fsync) before an independent worker-socket probe; eliminating the intermediate header-only write and overlapping descriptor persist with socket probe might lower launch-to-ready latency without changing final durable state.
approach: Two pa-daemon hunks only relative to product rust: worker/create.rs handle_create (None,false) removes header-only created.rewrite() before append_creation_prefix; supervisor/supervision.rs spawn_worker_process commits pid/start-id/lifecycle synchronously under descriptor lock, launches durable persist_worker task concurrently with read-only probe_worker_socket, joins task before successful return. Branch c73c0433 folds origin/rust 91eedb5d; measured predecessor ed43bce8f versus pure fb719b13 (later folds only unrelated pa-tui styling; final-head candidate c73c0433 not measured).
parity_notes: Final session JSONL content is identical: creation prefix and active state are in-memory before the same final rewrite. Descriptor pid/start identity is set synchronously prior to self-registration and liveness checks; descriptor is still persisted before successful connect/create response. Socket probe is read-only and independent of durable identity persist. On probe failure the task detaches, leaving same Starting-state durable descriptor. Crash mid-first-create before final rewrite can leave no session file instead of header-only; the lease still blocks concurrent open and stale-window reclamation plus durable create-command replay recovers. Wire protocol, RLM API, session replay, feature flags and macOS/Linux paths unchanged. Existing parity tests, family-edge e2e and full workspace test passed on measured candidate with serialized test threads. Optimization is discarded for no robust speedup; no PR is proposed.

validity.notes: All 120 trials validated, no exclusions. Same preserved cand VM, each suite six sequential invocations b,c,c,b,b,c, five trials each, binary sha/revision pinned per slot; initial calibration 0.162860s vs final 0.149918s (~7.95% lower duration) means drift exceeds observed 1–2% startup changes. Cold-start p95 dominated by outliers on both roles; daemon.boot p50 5.4 vs 5.5ms and msg_send p50 1.9 vs 2.2ms, below useful timing resolution and no robust regression/gain. Bench run labels include harness git_rev unknown/dirty: harness benchmark settings had unrelated WIP; product binary SHA256/revision and file swaps audited per slot. Measured exact base fb719b13, candidate ed43bce8f; subsequent two pa-tui-only folds put product branch on c73c0433/91eedb5d but are unmeasured. Historical first iteration gate at older b0afcdbe candidate failed family_edges; subsequent base/candidate exact fb719b13 B,C,C,B family tests all passed after #2828. Parallel workspace gate on ed43bce8f failed fixed-port OAuth test (error Address already in use); serialized full workspace gate passed. Final-head rerun aborted promptly at operator discard direction; do not relabel final-head gates or pair green.

decision: Orchestrator approved discard: startup p50 cold −1.82%, warm −1.36%, dwarfed by 7.95% calibration drift; no credible speedup, +330016 binary bytes, no PR. Preserve negative evidence and avoid claiming startup gain.
